en: Psalms 25
By David.

p.src: 1  To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

en: To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.
u.src: 1  To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

p.src: 2  My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

en: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.
u.src: 2  My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

p.src: 3  Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

en: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
u.src: 3  Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

p.src: 4  Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

en: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.
u.src: 4  Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

p.src: 5  Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

en: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.
u.src: 5  Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

p.src: 6  LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

en: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.
u.src: 6  LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

p.src: 7  Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

en: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.
u.src: 7  Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

p.src: 8  Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

en: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
u.src: 8  Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

p.src: 9  He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

en: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.
u.src: 9  He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

p.src: 10  All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

en: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
u.src: 10  All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

p.src: 11  For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

en: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.
u.src: 11  For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

p.src: 12  What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

en: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
u.src: 12  What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

p.src: 13  His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

en: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.
u.src: 13  His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

p.src: 14  The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

en: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.
u.src: 14  The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

p.src: 15  My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

en: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.
u.src: 15  My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

p.src: 16  Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

en: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.
u.src: 16  Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

p.src: 17  The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

en: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
u.src: 17  The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

p.src: 18  Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

en: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.
u.src: 18  Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

p.src: 19  Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

en: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.
u.src: 19  Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

p.src: 20  Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

en: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.
u.src: 20  Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

p.src: 21  Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.
u.src: 21  Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

p.src: 22  God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

en: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
u.src: 22  God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.
